important_caveats: IEX-only prices, volumes and top-of-book. IEX BBO is NOT the NBBO; penny-stock IEX spreads are wide (see medianSpreadBpsAtSignal), so the conservative fill model buys at the worst IEX ask + slippage. These estimated paper outcomes are NOT what a real order routed to the NBBO would have received.
Single trading day; small samples; descriptive only; no predictive or profitability claim.
The handwritten $50 / +22% / stop-at-buy-level rules are EXPLORATORY examples, not a validated strategy.

tierDefinition.label: Penny tier
tierDefinition.description: Latest observed IEX price < $1.00 (as-of replay clock)

dataset.coverage: IEX Exchange only (top-of-book quotes and trades on IEX). Not consolidated: IEX BBO is not the NBBO and IEX volume is a fraction of total U.S. volume. OTC securities not covered.

definitions.signal: first minute end E in the regular session where IEX last-trade return over the previous 15 min >= threshold, window fully inside the session, >= 2 IEX trades in window
definitions.tier: reference price (last IEX trade at or before window start, may be pre-market) < 1 USD
definitions.classification: return at 60 min after E (or session close if beyond): >= +5% continued; <= -5% reversed; otherwise stalled. failed = stalled | reversed. EXPLORATORY THRESHOLDS.
definitions.excursions: MFE/MAE: max IEX trade high / min trade low after E through 15:59 ET, relative to the signal price
definitions.relVol: window volume rate / regular-session volume rate before the window (null when < one window of baseline)
definitions.buyShare: inferred aggressor share (quote rule vs IEX BBO; IEX-only); null when classified volume < minClassifiedShares

limitations: Single trading day of IEX-only data: no prior close, no multi-day baseline, no consolidated volume; IEX BBO is not the NBBO.
Survivorship/selection: stored symbols are those observed below $5 at any time on the day (storage superset).
Small samples; descriptive only — no statistical significance, no claim of predictive value.
Trade breaks seen in the feed were not applied; corporate actions on the day are not adjusted.

matched.method: Nearest neighbour (with replacement) among failed (stalled|reversed) events of the same tier; Euclidean distance over z-scored signal-time features shared by both events (>= 3 required). Descriptive only; no statistical significance claimed.

handwrittenRule.label: HANDWRITTEN $50 EXAMPLE — EXPLORATORY, NOT VALIDATED; estimated paper fills, never exchange executions

notes.secFee: SEC Section 31 fee on sells: $27.80 per $1M of proceeds — assumption; verify the current SEC rate.
notes.taf: FINRA TAF on equity sells: $0.000166/share capped at $8.30 — assumption; verify the current FINRA rate.
notes.commission: Commission charged once per order, on its first fill.
notes.options: Options: only commission + SEC fee are modelled; per-contract ORF/TAF/exchange fees are not.

interpretation.trigger: +22% IEX trade return over 15 min (signal time = knowable time E)
interpretation.entry: market BUY submitted at E for floor($50 / slipped ask at E) shares; eligible from minute [E, E+60s); retried up to 5 minutes, then abandoned
interpretation.stop: stop SELL at the entry fill price ("sell @ buy level"); a stop cannot guarantee that price — modelled fill may be worse than the stop. contract_stop = fills.js stop semantics (triggers when the IEX bid or a trade reaches the stop). Because the entry fill is the worst ask plus slippage, the starting bid of the next minute is always at or below a buy-level stop, so contract_stop variants always trigger in the first protective minute. last_trade (ALTERNATIVE INTERPRETATION of "if dips — sell") = an IEX trade at/below the buy level in a completed minute triggers a market SELL from the next minute.
interpretation.takeProfit: limit SELL at entry × multiplier: 2.5× = "250% of purchase price" (default, more conservative), 3.5× = "250% gain"; both shown
interpretation.timeExit: ambiguous note "if not +/-10% for 15 min — sell @ current level" interpreted as: if all IEX trades in the 15 minutes after the entry fill stayed within ±10% of entry, submit a market SELL (stop/TP cancelled); variants with and without it shown
interpretation.oco: stop evaluated before take-profit within a minute (conservative); same-minute ambiguity noted
interpretation.sessionEnd: DAY orders expire at 16:00 ET; a position still open is marked to the IEX bid at close (unrealised)
interpretation.spreadGate: the policy-gate spread cap is NOT applied here (the handwritten rule has none); spread at signal is reported
